steps.title: Why TimeTrack needs your location
steps.body: When you tap Start Work, TimeTrack checks that you are at your assigned building. During a shift it checks that you are still there.
points: Checked when you start work, to confirm you are at your building
During a shift, also when the app is in the background

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.intro: TimeTrack needs the three permissions below to record your work time. Allow all of them to continue.
disclosure: Your location is checked on your phone only during an active shift, from Start Work to Finish Work, also when the app is in the background.
When you tap Start Work, your location is sent once to the server to confirm you are at your building.

Your employer sees when you start work. Once the "outside the work area" feature is released, your employer will also see when you leave or return to the work area, together with your own explanation.
Your employer does not see your location all the time. Nothing is checked before you start work or after you finish.
permissions.locationReason: Confirms you are at your building when you start work.
permissions.backgroundReason: Checks during your shift that you are still at the building, also when the app is in the background.
permissions.backgroundExpoGo: Expo Go cannot use background location. This step is skipped for testing only; the installed app requires it.
permissions.notificationsReason: Lunch reminders, a warning if you leave the building during a shift, and the notice shown while your shift is tracked.
guideAndroidAllTheTime: Tap the button below. Your phone opens TimeTrack's location settings.
Come back to TimeTrack. This screen updates by itself.
guideIosAlways: In the message, choose "Change to Always Allow".
guidePreciseAndroid: If no question appears: Open settings > Permissions > Location and turn on "Use precise location".
guideSettingsLocationIos: Choose "While Using the App" and turn on "Precise Location".
guideSettingsLocationAndroid: Choose "Allow all the time" and turn on "Use precise location".
permissions.continueHint: Allow all the permissions above to continue.
permissions.requestFailed: Open settings and allow it there, then come back to TimeTrack.
permissions.batteryBody: Some phones stop apps in the background to save battery, which stops shift tracking. Set TimeTrack to "Unrestricted" or "Not optimized". This step does not block you.
batteryTips: Samsung: Settings > Apps > TimeTrack > Battery > Unrestricted. Also remove TimeTrack from "Sleeping apps".
Xiaomi / Redmi / POCO: Settings > Apps > TimeTrack > Battery saver > No restrictions, and turn on Autostart.
Huawei / Honor: Settings > Battery > App launch > TimeTrack > Manage manually, all switches on.
permissions.startWorkMessage: TimeTrack needs location (all the time) and notifications before you can start work.
